question: Which Indian film was the first film to win the ‘Palme d'Or’ at Cannes Film Festival?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neecha Nagar**__.

__
 
• **Neecha Nagar was the first Indian film to win the ‘Palme d'Or’ at Cannes Film Festival**__.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Neecha Nagar** is the first film that took Indian cinema on the global stage was directed by **Chetan Anand**.

 
 
• ‘Palme d'Or’ is considered the highest honor for cinema.
 
• Neecha Nagar had a strong theme that captures India in 1946.
 
• The film talks about the gulf between the rich and poor in society.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Cannes film festival is an annual film festival held in Cannes, **France** which previews new films of all genres including documentaries from all around the world.

 
 
• It was founded in 1946.
